FULL.reason: vLLM rejects disabled chunked prefill when max_num_batched_tokens < max_model_len=4096.

diagnosis: The completed real comparison was not an isolated chunking intervention. It bundled chunking, total token budget, admission feasibility, and running-before-waiting scheduler behavior.
vllm_source_findings: SchedulerConfig says chunked prefill chunks based on remaining max_num_batched_tokens.
SchedulerConfig validation rejects max_num_batched_tokens < max_model_len when chunked prefill is disabled.
Scheduler.schedule initializes token_budget from max_num_scheduled_tokens/max_num_batched_tokens, schedules running requests first, then waiting requests.
If chunked prefill is disabled and a waiting request needs more tokens than remaining budget, scheduler breaks instead of chunking it.
